title: run is 280 lines and restore is finished in the compositor
body:
`compositor::run` holds GPU, shader and dmabuf setup; output and seat; the settings load; five event sources; `State` construction; the restored-workspace loop; the main loop and shutdown. `run` and `restore` both compute `columns`, `rows` and `frame::pane_area` before `State` exists, duplicating `State::grid` and `State::pane_area`.

`save::Saved::layouts` returns bare `Layout`s. The compositor then works out the app id prefix again (`format!("decade.w{id}.")`, also written in `workspace.rs`), calls `Workspace::with_tabs`, and re-applies `scratch` through `toggle_scratch`. `Pane.saved_tabs` is a field that exists so startup can `mem::take` it once. Writing goes the other way: `save::save` takes `&[Workspace]`. So the two directions of one format have different owners.

## Proposal

Extract the GPU/dmabuf, output/seat and event-source steps from `run`. Build `State` first and restore through `state.pane_area()`. `Saved::workspace(id, area) -> Result<(Workspace, Vec<(tab, id, PathBuf)>)>` in `save.rs`, with the prefix from a free `workspace::app_id_prefix(id)`, so `save.rs` owns both directions. The restored-workspace loop becomes the `start_workspace` from "Spawning a child is written four times and the pane variable is set in two places".
